newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes higher on exporter activity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes higher on exporter activity.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher on Tuesday on year-end U.S. dollar selling by exporters and dealers expected the performance of the U.S. dollar overseas to lead the local market's near-term trend.
The local unit ended at T$27.491 to the U.S. dollar against Monday's T$27.497 close. Turnover through dealers was a relatively slow US$301.5 million.
The market is closed from Wednesday to Friday for the New Year holiday. Trading resumes on Saturday.
"As there are no fresh local factors, the Taiwan dollar should just follow the dollar/yen movements overseas after the new year," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A very narrow T$27.48-50 trading range was seen for coming sessions.
